title: RNArrow — RNTuple Arrow Gateway
description: A C++ library and Arrow Flight gRPC server that reads CERN ROOT RNTuple physics data files and exposes the data as Apache Arrow — both in-process to Python via pybind11, and over the network through Arrow Flight streaming. Developed in the context of high-energy physics data analysis, motivated by experience as a former external member of the LHCb Collaboration at CERN (via Instituto de Fisica Corpuscular, IFIC). Targets the interoperability gap between ROOT's new columnar on-disk format (RNTuple, stable since ROOT 6.36) and the wider Arrow/pandas/Spark ecosystem.
